Luna.ai is an all-in-one AI prospecting platform that leverages AI to enhance sales outreach through personalized email campaigns, lead generation, and task management. It aims to simplify the process of finding and attracting new customers by automating many aspects of sales outreach.
Prospecting, Enrichment, Personalization, CRM Automation, Analytics
Product Features & Capabilities

275 million+ verified leads, ORBIT AI sales agent, AI-powered messaging and personalization, multichannel outreach (email, LinkedIn, cold calling), task management, seamless integrations with Salesforce, Hubspot, and Pipedrive, personalized templates, automated follow-ups, behavior tracking, performance analytics, scheduling for email and LinkedIn campaigns.
Free Plan: $0/month for 100 leads.
Starter Plan: $120/month for 300 leads.
Starter Plus: $360/month for 1,000 leads (most popular).
Premium Plan: $825/month for 2,500 leads.
Ultimate Plan: $1,500/month for 5,000 leads (best value).
Luna.ai has notable clients including MayaMaya, Sastrify, and NIE Number Fast, each achieving significant outcomes through the platform's AI-powered lead generation and outreach capabilities.

MayaMaya: An AI technology company in the software industry, MayaMaya utilized Luna.ai to enhance its sales process. They contacted 92 individuals, sent 160 emails, and secured 8 appointments, all at a lower cost than traditional methods. The principal, Vishwa Karthik, noted that Luna.ai's intuitive system provided high-quality leads and personalized communications, exceeding expectations.

Sastrify: This platform manages software subscriptions and aimed to improve outreach strategies. By automating email personalization, Luna.ai helped Sastrify enhance its outreach effectiveness, resulting in a 4.5 times increase in meetings booked compared to human efforts. Sales rep Zoi Lazaris praised the platform for its non-generic and effective email suggestions.

NIE Number Fast: This company assists foreigners in obtaining Spanish NIE numbers and achieved 19 new partnerships with Realtors in three months using Luna.ai. They contacted 1,699 Realtors, achieving a 44.21% open rate and a 4.59% reply rate, resulting in approximately €80,000 in new business.
